title: Prepare eve 0.5.0 release
summary: Prepared the eve 0.5.0 release metadata by promoting the post-0.4.0 dashboard filter fix into a dated changelog section and bumping the npm installer package metadata to 0.5.0.
userVisibleChange: The 0.5.0 release notes now document the Snapshots and Plans dashboard filter fix, and @nhestrompia/eve package metadata is ready for the 0.5.0 npm/GitHub release flow.

risks.title: Release still needs tag publication
risks.mitigation: scripts/prepare-release.sh prints the remaining tag and push steps; this snapshot records metadata preparation, not remote publication.

risks.title: Existing UI dependency audit warning remains
risks.mitigation: scripts/local-test.sh passed despite npm reporting one high-severity UI audit item; dependency remediation should be handled separately from this metadata release.

timeline.title: Reviewed prior release process
timeline.summary: Inspected EVE release snapshots for 0.4.0 and 0.3.0, then followed the 0.4.0 prepare-release script process.

timeline.title: Prepared 0.5.0 release metadata
timeline.summary: Added the post-0.4.0 dashboard filter fix to the changelog's Unreleased section, then ran scripts/prepare-release.sh 0.5.0 with release date 2026-07-27.

timeline.title: Verified release metadata and packages
timeline.summary: Ran shell syntax validation, npm installer tests, npm package dry-run, Go tests, and the full local verification script.

timeline.title: Reviewed release diff
timeline.summary: Ran the two-axis standards/spec review; standards found no violations and spec only noted the release was still in progress before the implementation commit and EVE record.

timeline.title: Committed 0.5.0 metadata
timeline.summary: Committed CHANGELOG.md and npm/eve package metadata as Prepare release 0.5.0.

decisions.title: Follow the 0.4.0 release script flow
decisions.rationale: The previous release snapshot established scripts/prepare-release.sh as the local release metadata path, including npm version updates and changelog promotion.

decisions.title: Release the merged dashboard filter fix as 0.5.0
decisions.rationale: The only product snapshot after 0.4.0 is the dashboard filter fix, so the 0.5.0 changelog summarizes that user-visible change.

decisions.title: Keep tagging outside this preparation commit
decisions.rationale: The existing release script and prior EVE decision leave Git tagging and tag push as explicit follow-up release steps.

validation.output:
Prepared eve release v0.5.0 for 2026-07-27.
Next release steps: commit these changes, record the release with EVE, commit the .eve record, tag v0.5.0, and push the tag.
npm pack --dry-run passed for @nhestrompia/eve@0.5.0; tarball nhestrompia-eve-0.5.0.tgz, 5 files.

Passed with elevated access for npm cache/logs and build tooling: Go tests, CLI version injection test, npm installer tests, npm pack dry-run, ui npm ci/test/build, and macOS approval app test/build. npm ci reported one existing high-severity audit warning.

Standards review found 0 hard violations and 0 judgment-call smells. Spec review found no metadata implementation issues; it noted the release workflow was still in progress before the implementation commit and EVE record.
